saw_lines: Lash and hair buyers reorder one trusted product for months and rarely compare brands once it works.
So a new buyer decides in the opening line whether to click, which is where the sale is won or lost.
Your site description promises orders until 20 Uhr with free delivery the next day, yet 0 of 5 ads name it. Put that promise in the first line of your next ads.
ads_1: Lash serum creative opening on next day delivery, tested against the 20% Revitalash opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and YouTube
